name: flexsim-webserver-toolkit
description: FlexSim WebServer 远程建模工具箱 —— 基于 Electron + Vue3 的桌面工具：远程浏览/操控 FlexSim 模型树、对象建模、运行控制与 handler 功能部署
author: 牛朝阳

scripts.start: npm run build && cross-env ELECTRON_DISABLE_SANDBOX=1 electron .
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n VITE,ELECTRON "vite" "wait-on tcp:5174 && cross-env ELECTRON_DISABLE_SANDBOX=1 electron ."

build.productName: FlexSim WebServer 远程建模工具箱
